items.problem: Folder-only bootstrap omitted externally linked UWP source and resources.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 399-415 versus UWP csproj linked items at lines 692-739; manual recovery consumed turns 7-25.
items.root_cause: The claimed complete inventory did not inspect old-style MSBuild Include/Link items.
items.change: Extend bootstrap tooling to expand project properties, copy resolvable external Compile/Page/ApplicationDefinition/Content/Resource items to Link destinations, include them in mapping/TODO processing, and fail on unresolved inputs. Tooling is preferred over prose because omission must be mechanically impossible; no existing script covered it.
items.expected_effect: Shared shell, styles, and assets are present and annotated before the agent edits, eliminating the manual copy and namespace/XAML cascade.
items.falsifiable_check: Re-running bootstrap on SimpleImaging reports 13 externally linked items, 20 seeded rows, and copied App.xaml.cs, MainPage.xaml.cs, and Styles\Styles.xaml with rewritten XAML namespaces.

items.problem: UWP suspension code compiled only after a fake event was added, silently losing persistence behavior.
items.evidence: session-log.txt lines 3409-3412 and 3537-3539; turn 17 added an event that was never raised.
items.root_cause: Suspension constructs were absent from both inventory and lifecycle guidance.
items.change: Add suspension patterns to the machine-readable inventory so TODO injection cannot be ignored, backed by a lifecycle recipe explaining incremental saves and Window.Closed/AppWindow.Closing. A prose-only fix was rejected because the inventory can route every occurrence.
items.expected_effect: Agents replace suspension persistence intentionally instead of fabricating a compile-only event.
items.falsifiable_check: Bootstrap injects a lifecycle TODO above each retained suspension subscription/deferral, and migrated source contains no fake Application.Suspending member.

items.problem: Build guidance assumed winapp build and launch discovery assumed only platform-qualified output.
items.root_cause: Instructions and scripts encoded one CLI version and one bin layout.
items.change: Make native dotnet build the documented path and add bin\Debug fallback discovery to both launch helper and validator. Tooling carries output-shape compatibility; prose only selects the supported build command.
items.expected_effect: The build command exists across environments and launch diagnosis finds either standard Debug layout.
items.falsifiable_check: No skill instruction invokes winapp build, and Test-AppLaunch -Target resolves an app built under either bin\x64\Debug or bin\Debug.
